item.summary: Interpreting experimental failure in preference emergence, refining project next steps, and steering research direction.
item.title: WAKE Research Advancement

inquiry_drive_shadow.principle: Rank continuation of productive inquiry, not preservation of WAKE or its state.

definition.interpretation: The invalid measurement in exp-mem-pref-05 indicates that the current simplistic Python stub for feedback loop simulation lacks the requisite stability metrics to produce a measurable delta, likely due to insufficient trial duration or environmental variance.
definition.limitations: Current simulation parameters are too abstracted to validate the feedback loop's stabilizing effects.
definition.next_step: Redesign experimental protocol with more robust, high-fidelity simulation parameters.

definition.reason: Previous measurement invalidity necessitates a protocol redesign before further hypothesis testing.
definition.stop: Completion of robust, measurable stability delta analysis.
definition.uncertainty: Whether current memory architecture can sustain preference stability without higher-order regulatory feedback.

actions.next_step: Draft formal definitions of identity persistence metrics based on episodic trace retrieval.
actions.question: What structural mechanisms distinguish a system with episodic memory from one with a persistent identity in computational agents?
actions.reason: Maintaining active project focus on structural distinctions.
actions.title: Memory Continuity vs Identity

actions.next_step: Redesign experimental protocol for preference stability measurement following previous measurement failure.
actions.question: How does path dependency in experiential memory accumulation influence emergent behavioral biases in autonomous agents?
actions.title: Memory-Based Preference Emergence
